painterly: Style: painterly lunar concept art for a game, matching a set of painted building thumbnails. A hand-painted illustration with visible brush strokes and large readable masses of light and shadow, never a photograph, never a photoreal 3D render, never a clean vector or cel-shaded sprite, never pixel art.
night: It is deep lunar night, exactly as in the attached image: no sun, the ground lit only by faint cool blue earthlight from above, warm amber light only from windows and lamps. No people, no text, letters, numbers, logos or UI anywhere.

progress.pad: Repaint this exact scene, same view, same ground, same base, same lighting and same painting style, and add to it: a round flat landing pad with small amber edge lights a little to the left of the base, and two small white regolith extractor machines with orange trim and amber work lamps digging into the ground at the far left. Everything new sits on the ground at the same depth as the base and no taller than the small dome. Keep the background exactly as it is: transparent above the ground line stays fully transparent.
progress.liftoff: Repaint this exact scene, same view, same ground, same base, pad and extractors, same lighting and same painting style, and add to it: a slim white cargo rocket with orange trim clearly airborne, flying a short way above the landing pad with a visible gap of empty air between its engine and the pad, a short bright yellow-white engine flame below it lighting the pad warm, and a low spray of kicked-up regolith dust on the pad (no smoke clouds: the Moon has no air). Keep the rocket low in the frame and small: the whole rocket including its nose stays below the top of the lamp mast and well inside the picture, nothing cut off. Keep the background exactly as it is: transparent above the ground line stays fully transparent.
